text_en: iOS roles were 29 of 1,399 deduplicated EU/UK engineering and product postings (2.1%) in an ATS scan of 234 companies, even though the company list was built around mobile-heavy fintech and consumer scale-ups.

payload.method: Scan of public ATS job boards, deduplicated one posting x N cities, titles classified by regex

text_en: 34% of the iOS postings in the EU/UK ATS scan were remote, a share in line with or above most other engineering families, but the pool is tiny.

payload.metric: Remote share of EU iOS postings
payload.method: Share of iOS-titled EU/UK postings flagged remote in the ATS scan

text_en: Senior iOS postings at product companies in European hubs (Wise, idealo, Zopa, SoundCloud and similar) collected 186 to 200+ LinkedIn applicants within 1-2 weeks of posting.

payload.metric: Applicants per senior iOS posting at hub product companies
payload.method: LinkedIn applicant counters read from cached posting cards; counts include clicks to external sites

text_en: Employed developers in Western Europe with 7+ years of experience who use Swift report a median salary of about EUR 92k, one of the highest-paid languages in that group.

payload.method: Own median computed from Stack Overflow 2025 raw responses (DE+NL+IE+CH+AT+BE+Nordics+LU, employed, 7+ years, USD to EUR 0.88)

text_en: UK permanent postings mentioning Apple iOS fell from 568 to 428 (-25%) between the 6-month windows ending in 2024 and 2026, and Swift postings fell from 98 to 71.

payload.metric: UK permanent postings, Apple iOS skill
payload.period: 6 months to 23 Oct 2026 vs same window 2024
payload.method: ITJobsWatch skill page counts, 2024 vs 2026 windows (2025 window excluded as unreliable)

text_en: The median advertised salary for UK permanent iOS Developer postings is GBP 75k (59 postings in the 6 months to 26 Oct 2026), up from about GBP 52.5k in 2024 while posting volume stayed flat.

payload.metric: UK iOS Developer permanent median salary
payload.method: ITJobsWatch median of advertised permanent salaries for the iOS Developer title

text_en: 55% of UK permanent postings that mention Swift also mention Kotlin, 51% mention Android and 27% mention React Native, so iOS-only requirements are no longer the norm.

payload.method: ITJobsWatch co-occurring skills on the Swift skill page

text_en: Monzo describes its senior mobile hiring loop as 2-3 weeks: recruiter, a 1-hour technical chat without code, a choice of a take-home capped at 4 hours or 1 hour of pair coding, then a 1-hour behavioural round and a 1-hour mobile system design round.

payload.method: Company-published description of its own process

text_en: Of 51 mobile-titled postings (iOS, Android or Mobile in the title) in an ATS pull of 8,407 open roles, none in Europe required LLM skills, so mobile plus AI is not a distinct European market.

payload.method: Regex over title and full text of public Ashby/Greenhouse/Lever postings from about 110 AI-native, SaaS and fintech companies

text_en: UK permanent postings mentioning Flutter fell from 53 to 23 (-57%) between the 6-month windows ending in 2024 and 2026, the steepest decline among mobile skills.

payload.period: 6 months to 23 Oct 2026 vs same window 2024
payload.method: ITJobsWatch skill page counts, 2024 vs 2026 windows

text_en: Kotlin Multiplatform grew from 7% of cross-platform developers in 2024 to 18% in 2025, and from under 1% to about 3% of the top-10k App Store apps by mid-2026.

payload.method: JetBrains survey figures as reported in State of Kotlin 2026

text_en: Kotlin is mentioned in 59% of Lead/Staff/Architect mobile postings in the EU/UK against 12% of iOS postings, and mentoring appears in 65% against 27%, so moving up a level means Android literacy and people skills.

payload.metric: Kotlin mention, Lead/Staff vs iOS postings
payload.method: Keyword presence in LinkedIn posting descriptions (EU/UK); presence of a word, not a stated requirement

text_en: The median total compensation reported for software engineering managers in the UK is GBP 151k (p25 GBP 110k, p75 GBP 229k), pulled upward by Big Tech.

payload.metric: UK engineering manager median total compensation
payload.method: Self-reported total compensation on Levels.fyi, all EM roles (not mobile-specific)

text_en: Monzo's Engineering Director (EU) posting describes a 3-4 week process: a 30-minute recruiter call, a 1-hour leadership conversation, then a loop of four 1-hour interviews.

payload.method: Company-published description of its own process
payload.source_name: Monzo job posting (via Accel jobs board)

text_en: PredictLeads counted 6,633 AI engineering postings in Europe in July 2026 versus 4,221 in July 2025 (+57%), and 31,718 across March-August 2026, led by the UK (6,501), Germany (5,524), France (2,894) and Spain (2,426).

payload.metric: European AI engineering postings, July y/y
payload.method: Vendor count of AI engineering postings; includes data-labelling gig platforms (Mindrift 1,430, Alignerr 159) that are not engineering jobs

text_en: The share of job postings that mention AI is 15% in Ireland, 13% in Spain and 9% in the UK, and Spain had 81 AI-titled postings in Q1 2026 versus 8 in Q1 2022.

payload.metric: Share of postings mentioning AI, Spain
payload.method: Indeed Hiring Lab posting analysis

text_en: 91% of 33 live European AI-engineering postings (30 of 33) mention agents, and 88% (29 of 33) ask for experience shipping LLM features to production.

payload.method: Regex over full text of 33 European AI-engineering postings from about 110 companies' public ATS boards; mention, not strict requirement

text_en: 61% of 33 live European AI-engineering postings (20 of 33) mention evals, and the median stated experience is 5 years across the 15 postings that name a number.

payload.method: Regex over full text of 33 European AI-engineering postings; years taken from the 15 postings that state them

text_en: Only 2 of 33 live European AI-engineering postings (6%) mention fine-tuning or PyTorch, so the role is mostly applied work on top of existing models rather than model training.

payload.metric: AI-engineering postings mentioning fine-tuning or PyTorch
payload.method: Regex over full text of 33 European AI-engineering postings

text_en: Across 39 European AI-native postings with a EUR salary range, the median is EUR 100k (p25 EUR 80k, p75 EUR 140k), with medians of EUR 135k for lead, EUR 110k for senior and EUR 58.8k for mid-level.

payload.metric: Median posted salary, European AI-native postings
payload.method: Median of posted salary ranges in EUR across 39 vacancies

text_en: Interview processes for AI engineer roles at 51 companies have a median of 4 steps (range 2 to 7) and take 2-6 weeks end to end.

payload.method: Field Guide summary of about 80 published process descriptions from 1,765 postings

text_en: UK contract postings mentioning LLM rose from 120 to 423 to 1,141 across the 6-month windows ending in 2024, 2025 and 2026.

payload.method: ITJobsWatch skill page counts for contract roles

text_en: The median advertised salary for permanent AI Engineer roles in the UK is GBP 87.5k (p10 GBP 52.6k, p90 GBP 112.5k), up 4.5% year on year.

payload.metric: UK AI Engineer permanent median salary
payload.method: ITJobsWatch figures for the AI Engineer title as summarised by Sharpcode

text_en: The UK median permanent salary for Machine Learning Engineer postings fell from GBP 92.5k in 2024 to GBP 70k in 2026 as the title is applied to more ordinary roles.

payload.metric: UK ML Engineer permanent median salary
payload.method: ITJobsWatch median advertised salary for the title, 2024 vs 2026 windows

text_en: US Indeed postings for Forward Deployed Engineer rose from 643 to 5,330 (+729%) between April 2025 and April 2026, from a small base.

payload.method: Indeed posting counts as reported by a recruiting blog (single dataset)

text_en: 90% of Solutions/Pre-sales Engineer postings (n=39) require prior pre-sales or SE experience, versus 0% of FDE postings, and only 1 of those 39 asks for production code.

payload.method: Regex over full text of European customer-facing technical postings in public ATS boards (Databricks excluded)

text_en: A local language is required in about one in three European solutions-engineering postings: German in 19%, Spanish in 13% and French in 8% (120 postings, Databricks excluded).

payload.method: Regex over full text of 120 European customer-facing technical postings

text_en: Solutions, Sales Engineer and FDE roles have the highest remote share of the large EU engineering pools at 44% (137 postings), though remote is usually tied to a country or the EMEA region.

payload.method: Share of deduplicated EU/UK postings flagged remote in the ATS scan

text_en: Self-reported total compensation for Sales Engineers in Spain has a median of EUR 99.8k (p25 EUR 55.8k, p75 EUR 138k), skewed toward US multinationals.

payload.metric: Spain Sales Engineer median total compensation
payload.method: Self-reported total compensation, all levels

text_en: Among 1,771 active IT postings on Tecnoempleo, ciberseguridad has 254, python 245, java 227, devops 219 and inteligencia artificial 195, versus only 21 for ios and 21 for android.

payload.method: Keyword counts on the site's full-text search, an upper bound because matches include mentions

text_en: Only 154 of 1,771 active Tecnoempleo IT postings (9%) carry the 100% remoto tag, so fully remote work in Spain is a small minority.

payload.metric: Fully remote share of Spanish IT postings
payload.method: Count of postings with the 100% remoto modality filter

text_en: 68% of IT job postings on InfoJobs in January-August 2025 offered some remote option, hybrid included (35,613 postings).

payload.metric: Spanish IT postings offering remote option
payload.method: InfoJobs posting analysis; the option includes hybrid arrangements

text_en: Adecco's 2026 ICT salary guide lists native Android/iOS developers in Spain at EUR 45-58k for mid level and EUR 65-78k for senior.

payload.method: Recruiter salary guide bands, gross annual

text_en: Spain has the lowest median software engineer pay of the four large economies Ravio compares: EUR 55.9k, versus Germany EUR 74.1k, Netherlands EUR 73.2k and France EUR 65.6k.

payload.method: Employer-reported compensation data

text_en: The median UK contract day rate for Swift roles fell from GBP 525 in 2024 to GBP 420 in 2026 (p10 GBP 370, p90 GBP 537), with 102 contract postings.

payload.method: ITJobsWatch median advertised contract day rate

text_en: The median UK contract day rate for AI Engineer is GBP 588 (London GBP 600, outside London GBP 500, p10-p90 GBP 421-875), up 11.9% year on year.

payload.metric: UK AI Engineer contract day rate
payload.method: ITJobsWatch figures for the AI Engineer title as summarised by Sharpcode

text_en: The share of UK contracts outside IR35 fell from 47% in 2024 to 42% in 2025, while inside-IR35 contracts rose from 29% to 35%.

payload.method: IPSE survey of contractors

text_en: 35% of EU/UK engineering and product postings (495 of 1,399) in an ATS scan were remote, though remote is usually tied to a country or region.

payload.metric: Remote share of EU/UK engineering postings
payload.method: Share of deduplicated postings flagged remote in the ATS scan

text_en: Only 44 of the 2,000 freshest postings on the Himalayas remote board (2.2%) had no geographic restriction, while the US was an allowed country in 1,090 (55%).

payload.metric: Remote board postings with no country restriction
payload.method: Count over the 2,000 most recent postings in the Himalayas API feed (about 10 hours of postings)

text_en: In the October 2026 Hacker News Who is hiring thread, 52% of 263 posts were remote, but only 27% mentioned Europe or the UK and 16% said US only.

payload.metric: HN Who is hiring: remote and region mix
payload.method: Regex over top-level posts in the thread via the Algolia API
